examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default horizontal hairline. Switch `orientation` and type a `label` to see it update live.

examples.name: WithLabel
examples.summary: Separator carrying a centered label ("OR"); the hairline splits around the text. Provide the label via the `label` prop or the default slot.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Separator from '@aziontech/webkit/separator'
</script>

<template>
  <Separator
    orientation="horizontal"
    label="OR"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Orientations
examples.summary: Both orientations side by side: a horizontal hairline spanning its container width and a vertical hairline spanning its container height.
